5037204493814.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Drawstring Closure
A drawstring provides an adjustable way to gather the opening. It lets you change the fit around the intended contents or support without a fixed opening size.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

1234550002514.variantName: 152cm Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with Realistic Snow Covered Hinged Branches, Sturdy Base, Easy Assembly and Compact
1234550002514.sourceDescription:
Bring the magical beauty of a winter wonderland into your home with the 152cm Snow Flocked Christmas Tree. Featuring beautifully snow-dusted branches and a full, realistic appearance, this artificial Christmas tree creates an elegant festive centrepiece for your seasonal celebrations.

Realistic Snow-Flocked Appearance

Designed with lush, full branches covered in a delicate white flocked finish, this Christmas tree recreates the charming appearance of a snow-covered winter forest. Its attractive design provides the perfect backdrop for Christmas baubles, hanging ornaments, fairy lights and garlands.

Durable and Sturdy Construction

Made with durable materials, this artificial Christmas tree is designed for repeated seasonal use. The sturdy base provides reliable support, while the branches offer space for displaying your favourite Christmas decorations.

Easy Assembly and Setup

Featuring a convenient hinged branch design, the tree branches can be opened and arranged to create a fuller appearance. Its practical construction makes seasonal decorating easier and more convenient. After the festive season, the tree can be disassembled and stored away ready for future celebrations. Its reusable design makes it a practical addition to your Christmas decorations.

Perfect Festive Centrepiece

With its beautiful snow-covered appearance and traditional Christmas tree shape, this decorative tree complements a variety of festive interior styles, helping create a warm and welcoming Christmas atmosphere.
REALISTIC SNOW FLOCKED DESIGN – Features beautifully white snow-dusted branches that recreate the appearance of a winter wonderland, adding a magical touch to your Christmas decorations.
152CM ARTIFICIAL CHRISTMAS TREE – Generous 152cm height makes this decorative tree an attractive festive centrepiece for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways and other indoor spaces.
FULL AND LUSH BRANCHES – Designed with multiple branches to create a fuller, natural-looking appearance, providing plenty of space for baubles, ornaments, tinsel and Christmas lights.
DURABLE REUSABLE CONSTRUCTION – Made with durable materials for repeated seasonal use, offering a practical alternative to purchasing a new Christmas tree every year.
HINGED BRANCH DESIGN – Convenient hinged branches open out for easier assembly and arrangement, helping create an attractive and well-shaped Christmas tree.
STURDY SUPPORT BASE – Includes a sturdy base designed to provide reliable support and help keep the Christmas tree securely positioned.
EASY ASSEMBLY AND STORAGE – Designed for convenient seasonal setup and disassembly, allowing the tree to be packed away after Christmas for future celebrations.
PERFECT FESTIVE HOME DECORATION – Creates a beautiful winter-inspired display and complements traditional, modern and rustic Christmas decorating themes.

Versatile Applications: This quilted Christmas tree kit enables you to sew a soft fabric tree that seamlessly complements your seasonal decorations, spreading a festive atmosphere across your fireplace mantel, desk, workbench, or shop window

What is oxo-biodegradable plastic?
Oxo-biodegradable plastic is ordinary plastic to which small amounts of metal salts (a prodegradant additive) has been added during the manufacturing process. The big difference between oxo-biodegradable and ordinary plastic is that if oxo-biodegradable plastic escapes collection and ends up in the open environment as litter, it will degrade and biodegrade in a similar way to nature’s waste.

How does it work?
In the presence of oxygen, the prodegradant additive breaks the molecular chains in the polymer, and at the end of its useful life the product will degrade and biodegrade, that is it will be consumed by bacteria and fungi, after the additive has reduced the molecular weight to a level which permits them access to the carbon and hydrogen.

Product Description

 This DIY beaded Christmas tree craft kit comes with all necessary accessories for you to build a shiny handmade tabletop Christmas tree.
 It features green beaded branches, assorted colorful ornament charms and an elegant angel tree topper, creating bright festive holiday atmosphere.
 It is a fun creative handmade project perfect for holiday DIY time, allowing you to assemble beads and decorations step by step.
 After assembly, this mini beaded tree can be displayed on tables, desks or shelves as lovely Christmas tabletop decor.

Finished in a charming baby pink tone, these ornaments are designed to stand out without overwhelming your overall theme. Their glittered detail and jewel-like look make them especially effective when paired with lights, metallic accents or other festive hanging decorations. Use them to refresh your Christmas tree, brighten a party display or complete a coordinated seasonal scheme with a delicate, stylish touch.

Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. Blue-green artificial spruce needles give this 35 cm wreath a cool winter colour. It is 10 cm deep and comes with a 28 cm iron hanger, so you can plan its position and projection together.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height. For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room.

8721288985514.sourceDescription:
This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree is an exquisite addition to any holiday decor, featuring a fusion of PVC and metal materials offering both beauty and durability. Measuring an appealing height suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, this Christmas tree boasts a stylish cone shape, enhanced by versatile warm white LED strip lights. With eight stunning display modes, it invites festive creativity through its modern flexibility, powered simply via USB connectivity. Requiring easy assembly involving two people with a screwdriver, it promises a swift transformation from a simple start to a substantial festive centerpiece. The tree's elegance lies in its detail, from the lifelike tips mimicking natural foliage to the secure metal base providing stability and grandeur throughout the holidays. Whether as a delightful living room focal point or a warming decor piece on patios shielded from the elements, this tree can mold to environments while maintaining a fresh seasonal spirit. Users will appreciate its adaptability, with instructions guiding efficient setup and maintenance, allowing homeowners to focus on creating lasting festive memories. Ideal for anyone seeking contemporary style with traditional holiday values, its combination of materials, color, and design ensures a cherished and personalized addition to any holiday home landscape.
This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree is a vision of modern festive decor
Its cone-shaped structure combines simplicity with style, sitting beautifully in any interior space like a living room
Its appealing green hue, highlighted with white, adds a subtle yet eye-catching brilliance, perfect for setting a festive mood for all ages
As it stands elegantly, it conjures a heartwarming ambiance ideal for holiday celebrations, family gatherings, or any special occasion needing a touch of holiday charm
Craftsmanship: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree promises durability and presents a realistic appearance, complementing its metal stand designed to offer sturdy support
The blend of these materials ensures the tree remains robust and visually appealing for many festive seasons while being safer for indoor use
The seamless union of materials creates a welcoming and festive atmosphere

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
